---
title: "D0_Famille_unique"
format: html
---

Ce script sert à mettre en ordre la base des variables qui n'ont qu'une seule occurence, d'où le "unique". Donc tous les événements renouvelables seront traités dans d'autres bases. 

```{r Setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)
```

```{r Import}
M1_F2 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/clean_data/aut26/thoa_identite_notag.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

### 1.1.1 Importer la base
M4_L0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_fa_04.sas7bdat")
```

```{r M4_L0 to M4_L1}
### 1.1.2 Identifier les colonnes vides
empty_cols_M4_L0 <- M4_L0 %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "nb_empty_cells") %>% 
  filter(nb_empty_cells == nrow(M4_L0))

### 1.1.3 Créer vecteur avec le nom des variables à retirer
vars_vides <- empty_cols_M4_L0$variable

### 1.1.4 Retirer les variables, corriger les formats et les NA character
M4_L1 <- M4_L0 %>%
  select(-all_of(vars_vides)) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%  
  select(-c("tab_db",
            "fa_type")) %>% 
  select(-starts_with("id_"), id_anonymat, id_sep, id_date_nais, id_date_creation, id_sexe) %>% 
  relocate(fa_date_creation, id_date_creation, id_anonymat, id_sep, id_date_nais, id_sexe) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = replace_when(
      id_anonymat,
      id_anonymat %in% M1_F2$id_module ~ str_sub(id_sep, 7, 11)
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_module = case_when(
      str_sub(id_sep, 7, 11) == id_anonymat ~ str_sub(id_sep, 1, 5)
    ),
    .after = id_sep
  )

rm(list = c("empty_cols_M4_L0", "vars_vides", "M4_L0"))
```

Corriger les doublons

```{r M4_L1 to M4_L2}

M4_L2 <- M4_L1 %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  mutate(n = n(),
         .after = id_module) %>% 
  relocate(fo_revenus_corr, .after = id_module) %>%
  relocate(id_sexe, .after = id_module) %>%
  arrange(n, id_anonymat) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter_out(n == 2 & is.na(id_module)) %>% 
  select(-n, -id_date_creation, -id_sep) %>%
  rows_patch(
    M1_F2 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat, id_date_nais, id_sexe),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  )

```
Je peux repartir de M4_L2 pour faire le foyer puis le nombre d'enfants/freres/soeurs

# Parents

## Réduire les nombre de variables
Je vais commencer à partir des parents, et fratrie
```{r}

sub_pf <- M4_L2 %>% 
  select(pf_pere_prenom, pf_pere_mois_nais, pf_pere_an_nais, pf_pere_decede,
         pf_pere_mois_deces, pf_pere_an_deces, pf_pere_etudes, pf_pere_prof,
         pf_pere_statut, pf_pere_entreprise, pf_pere_qual, 
         pf_mere_prenom,
         pf_mere_mois_nais, pf_mere_an_nais, pf_mere_decede, pf_mere_mois_deces,
         pf_mere_an_deces, pf_mere_etudes, pf_mere_prof, pf_mere_statut,
         pf_mere_entreprise, pf_mere_qual,
         pf_union_parents, pf_union_mois, pf_union_an, pf_parents_interromp,
         pf_interromp_par, pf_interromp_mois, pf_interromp_an,
         pf_raison_muco) %>% 
  colnames()

pere <- M4_L2 %>% 
  select(starts_with("pf_pere")) %>% 
  colnames()

mere <- M4_L2 %>% 
  select(starts_with("pf_mere")) %>% 
  colnames()

parents <- dplyr::setdiff(sub_pf, union(pere, mere))

P4_C0 <- M4_L2 %>% 
  select(fa_date_creation, id_anonymat, id_module, id_sexe, id_date_nais, all_of(sub_pf)) %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub("^pf_pere", "fa_pap", .x), all_of(pere)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub("^pf_mere", "fa_pam", .x), all_of(mere)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ gsub("^pf_", "fa_par_", .x), all_of(parents)) %>% 
  rename(
    "fa_pap_nais_mois" = "fa_pap_mois_nais",
    "fa_pap_nais_an" = "fa_pap_an_nais",
    "fa_pap_deces" = "fa_pap_decede",
    "fa_pap_deces_mois" = "fa_pap_mois_deces",
    "fa_pap_deces_an" = "fa_pap_an_deces",
    "fa_pam_nais_mois" = "fa_pam_mois_nais",
    "fa_pam_nais_an" = "fa_pam_an_nais",
    "fa_pam_deces" = "fa_pam_decede",
    "fa_pam_deces_mois" = "fa_pam_mois_deces",
    "fa_pam_deces_an" = "fa_pam_an_deces",
    "fa_par_union" = "fa_par_union_parents",
    "fa_par_union_int" = "fa_par_parents_interromp",
    "fa_par_union_int_nat" = "fa_par_interromp_par",
    "fa_par_union_int_mois" = "fa_par_interromp_mois",
    "fa_par_union_int_an" = "fa_par_interromp_an",
    "fa_par_union_int_muco" = "fa_par_raison_muco"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_pam_prenom = str_to_upper(fa_pam_prenom),
    fa_pap_prenom = str_to_upper(fa_pap_prenom),
   fa_pam_prenom = replace_when(
      fa_pam_prenom,
      fa_pam_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    ))

```


## Identifier participants

```{r}

vars_check <- P4_C0 %>%
  select(fa_pap_prenom:fa_par_union_int_muco) %>%
  names()

P4_C1 <- P4_C0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    fa_pa_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

```
